checks.explanation: D-selection is on page 1 and itemized prices begin on page 1, so the disclosure is on the same page as the prices it accompanies.
The basic services includesText lists arrangements conference, shelter of remains, notices, permits/authorizations, and coordination with cemetery, crematory or other third parties.
No second mandatory fee for services, facilities or overhead appears; only the basic services fee is described as non-declinable.
No D-embalming disclosure is printed in the transcription, so placement next to the embalming price cannot be tested.
No text states that embalming is required for direct cremation, immediate burial, or closed-casket funeral without viewing.
D-alt-container is on page 2 and the direct cremation range is on page 2, so it is on the same page as the prices it accompanies.
Direct cremation is offered with an option using a container provided by the purchaser, with no statement that a casket is required.
The list shows direct cremation wording but shows no cash-advance billing for a crematory fee that would create an inconsistency.
Forwarding, receiving, direct cremation and immediate burial each have itemized prices, and no goods or services appear only inside a package, description or policy.
No optional package combining goods and services at one price is offered; forwarding, receiving, direct cremation and immediate burial are not packages.
No text beyond the prescribed disclosure wording asserts that law, a cemetery or a crematory requires a purchase.
No claim that goods or services delay decomposition long-term or protect the body from gravesite substances appears.
No other wording undercuts a required disclosure, and the unfilled blank in the alternative-container disclosure alone is not a concern for this check.
